column3: Alliance, day 54, standard game. Briefing done; the nine opening advice topics in the Advice index; no other messages.
Alliance, day 149. Fleet 1 (Corellian Corvette, Medium Transport) in transit Ithor to Coruscant. About 400 s after load the Battle at Coruscant alert opens against Judicator and Tyrant.
Empire, day 2, standard game. Briefing just ended, nothing ordered. Fleet 1 (ISD, Carrack, six TIE squadrons) at Coruscant.
Empire, day 28. One TIE squadron moved from Fleet 1 onto Coruscant; the planet's Fighter Squadrons tab lists TIE Fighters.
Empire, day 30. Fleet 1 blockading Yaga Minor; the Battle at Yaga Minor alert (Alliance breaking the blockade) opens within 12 s of load. Unedited.
Empire, day 30. Same as empire-day030-yaga-alert but the ISD's hyperdrive was edited out. Same alert within 12 s.
Empire, about day 37. Fleet 1 (with 3 Stormtrooper Regiments) in transit Coruscant to Alliance-held Yaga Minor; arrives about day 43 and blockades. No battle.
Empire, day 53. Fleet 1 in orbit of Alliance-held, ungarrisoned Yaga Minor with 3 Stormtrooper Regiments. Right-click Fleet 1, Planetary Assault: succeeds (ground-assault report flow).
Empire, day 101. After Yaga Minor was taken, 1 Stormtrooper Regiment re-embarked on Fleet 1, now in orbit of Alliance-held Drall (Corellian). For a weak assault (failure or casualties).
Empire, day 415, Huge galaxy, Easy. Fleet 1 holds all eight Imperial capitals and 16 TIE squadrons at Coruscant; a Battle Alert opens about 21 days later.
Empire, day 488 (the game slot 5 held; keep this copy unchanged).
Empire, Huge galaxy. Edited (route 1): the Death Star order was set one short, and the original finished Death Star 1 into Fleet 6 at Coruscant.
Empire, day 660, Huge galaxy. Death Star fleet at Coruscant; the Battle at Coruscant alert opens on day 676, after a Carida alert on day 669.
Alliance, about day 731. Edited: an Imperial ISD order converted to a Death Star; the original completed it as Devastator at Coruscant.
Alliance, about day 830. Same game after withdrawing from the second Coruscant battle. The Imperial Death Star is at Coruscant but did not join Alliance-initiated battles there.
Empire day 128: Fleet 1 (1 Stormtrooper Regiment) over Alliance Selonia; assault fails, destroys 1 of 2 Alliance Army Regiments

Alliance, day 1119; made and given by David Adams (github.com/davidadas, author of rebellion2). Fleet 1 reaches Imperial Coruscant on day 1123 against Fleets 16 (with Death Star 1), 190 and 192, 22 TIE squadrons; Fleet 2 at Delaya carries 30 X-wing squadrons.

Alliance, day 1169; David Adams's Coruscant save played on. Fleet 2 (59 fighter squadrons) in transit to Coruscant; the Battle at Coruscant alert opens on day 1173 against Death Star 1 and 23-24 TIE squadrons, enough for Attack Death Star.
Alliance, day 817: Fleet 1 (two Alliance Fleet Regiments) in transit to Imperial-held Orto (three shields); arrives day 911 and blockades.
Alliance, day 927: Fleet 1 blockading Orto; Planetary Assault greyed (three shields), bombardment rows enabled.
Empire, day 211: Tralus taken on day 189 (KDY-150 killed one regiment), the Corellia assault repulsed on day 210.
Empire, day 220: Imperial Fleets 1 and 2 blockade Alliance-held Talus, which holds three Alliance officers and no regiment.
Empire, day 277: Talus taken by assault on day 272; its three Alliance officers are at Corfai.
Empire, day 660, edited: Fleet 6 TIE squadrons emptied; at the day-676 Battle at Coruscant (Take Command) the Alliance AI runs the trench and destroys the Death Star.
Alliance, about day 731, edited: Leia moved into the Empire Jail; she escapes within about 50 days and arrives at Yavin.
Empire, day 660, edited: Palpatine moved into the Alliance Jail; the Alliance wins the Standard game between days 682 and 692.
